* Analyze model performance against real\-world data to ensure accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Identify and address discrepancies between expected and actual model behavior, providing actionable insights to improve model performance.
* Implement automated testing strategies and pipeline to streamline model validation processes.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers and ML Engineers to improve data quality, enhance model performance, and ensure efficient deployment of validated models.
* Ensure that validation processes adhere to data governance policies and industry standards.
* Communicate validation results, insights, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders, including product managers and leadership teams.


**Required Qualifications**
* PhD, Master’s, or Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with hands\-on experience in model validation.
* Minimum of 3 years of industry experience.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Significant experience working in the energy sector, particularly in energy systems, grid automation, or smart grid technologies.
* Proven experience in validating AI/ML models, ensuring they meet business and technical requirements.
* Excellent knowledge of statistical techniques, model performance metrics, and validation methodologies for AI/ML models.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or MATLAB.
* Experience with data wrangling, feature engineering, and preparing datasets for model validation.
* Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn) and model evaluation techniques.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and deployment of models in cloud environments.
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar to effectively present validation results and insights.
* Familiarity with big data tools and technologies, such as Hadoop, Kafka, and Spark.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and validation standards in the energy sector.
* Knowledge of distributed computing environments and model deployment at scale.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex validation results to non\-technical stakeholders.

EDA’s signature Earth Observation mission, the EarthDaily Constellation, is currently under construction. Once operational in 2026, the EarthDaily Constellation will be the most powerful global change detection and change monitoring system ever developed, capable of generating unprecedented predictive analytics and insights. It will combine with the EarthPipeline data processing system to provide unprecedented, scientific\-grade data of the world every day, positioning EDA to meet the growing needs of diverse industries.


OUR TEAM


Our global, enterprise\-wide team represents a variety of business lines and is made up of sales, marketing and support professionals, data scientists, software engineers, project managers and finance, HR, and IT professionals.


READY TO LAUNCH?

Candidates must have full\-time availability during the business hours of 9am\-5:30pm Monday through Friday.**


PREPARE FOR IMPACT!


Reporting to the Director of Finance and working closely with other members of the Finance team, the Tax Manager is a hands\-on role responsible for corporate tax compliance, indirect tax, cross\-border tax strategy, and tax provision reporting. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of both U.S. and Canadian tax, and sound judgement in navigating cross\-border and transfer pricing issues. They will also have the ability to translate complex tax topics into clear guidance for internal stakeholders and will play a key role in implementing scalable processes and managing tax risk as the company grows.  

  

Responsibilities include:


Tax Compliance \& Reporting

* Oversee corporate tax compliance for both U.S. and Canada, including federal, state/provincial, and local filings
* Ensure timely and accurate filing of corporate income tax, sales tax (GST/HST/PST/VAT), and other indirect taxes
* Manage quarterly and annual tax provision calculations under US GAAP and IFRS
* Maintain compliance with transfer pricing regulations and prepare required documentation
* Coordination of SR\&ED filings
* Support accurate tax reporting and compliance related to withholding tax and intercompany distributions


Tax Planning \& Strategy* Develop and implement tax\-efficient strategies to optimize the company's global tax position
* Identify and mitigate cross\-border tax risks, including permanent establishment exposure
* Advise on tax implications of business operations, M\&A, restructurings, and new market entry
* Monitor U.S. and Canadian tax law changes and assess business impact


Audit \& Risk Management* Lead responses to tax audits and inquiries from CRA, IRS, and other authorities
* Maintain strong internal controls over tax compliance and financial reproting
* Partner with legal, accounting, and finance to proactively mange tax risk


Collaboration \& Advisory

* Advise internal stakeholders on payroll tax, sales tax, international tax, and other operational matters
* Coordinate with external tax advisors and auditors to ensure compliance and alignment with best practices
* Collaborate with country subsidiaries on accurate tax reporting and compliance
* Support implementation of tax technology or automation solutions where applicable
* Other duties as required


YOUR PAST MISSIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or related field
* CPA designation (U.S. or Canada) is required
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in U.S. and Canadian corporate tax
* Hands\-on experience with transfer pricing, cross\-border structuring, and indirect taxes
* Prior experience with SR\&ED claims is an asset
* Experience with ERPs (NetSuite experience an asset)
* Experience in dealing with multiple currencies


YOUR TOOLKIT

* Strong understanding of US GAAP and IFRS tax reporting
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain tax issues to non\-tax stakeholders
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines in a fast\-paced environment


YOUR COMPENSATION


Base Salary Range: $120,000\-$150,000 CAD annually


The range of $120,000\-$150,000 annually, depends on job\-related skills, experience, training, education, location and business needs. The range is based on BC\-derived compensation for this role. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. Only in rare and exceptional circumstances, when a candidate has the experience, skills, and expertise to exceed those required for the position, would we consider paying at the top of the range for this role.


OUR SPACE


We’d love to welcome you to our world of software for space. We have a shared passion for building production critical systems that generate near real\-time views of Earth from satellites that power real\-world applications like disaster mitigation, environmental monitoring and crop yield improvements. It’s a fun, fast paced, exciting environment where we hold innovation, team work, honesty and trust as our core values.


To make the most innovative products that serve our customers, we recognize the role that each of us plays in Diversity and Inclusion at EarthDaily. We draw from our diverse crew of exceptional team members and encourage and empower our team members to express themselves regardless of identity, race, colour, ancestry, place of origin, religion, marital status, family status, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity or expression.

**This is a hybrid role, with some ongoing, in\-office work and collaboration required.**


WHY EARTHDAILY ANALYTICS?

* Competitive compensation, full benefits and flexible time off
* Be part of a meaningful mission as part of one of Canada’s most innovative space companies that are developing sustainable solutions for our planet
* Work from home opportunities (hybrid)
* Great work environment, team and one of the best office locations in Vancouver (right over the water in the new Vancouver Convention Centre)

**Data Scientist, Data \& Analytics**
 BC Cancer
   

  

 Vancouver, BC
   

  

 The Data Scientist acts in accordance with the cognitive computing priorities of BC Cancer to build and increase capacity and support for our cognitive computing learning systems to create and enhance insights gained from analyzing quality data. The Data Scientist is adept at using large data sets and machine learning models to find opportunities for product and process optimization as well as to test the effectiveness of different courses of action. They use a variety of data mining / data analysis techniques, and utilize their knowledge of the full AI product lifecycle of development, testing, implementation, and maintenance. The Data Scientist will drive business results with their data\-based insights and works with a wide range of stakeholders and functional teams. The Data Scientist will discover solutions hidden in large data sets and work with stakeholders to improve business processes and outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work as a senior data scientist and strategist for Data and Analytics, to foster and develop a solid and sustainable data science foundation and competency for BC Cancer
* Work closely with clinical and leadership teams across BC Cancer programs and the health authority to strategize, develop, and implement AI products
* Identify, clean, and integrate large sets of structured and unstructured datasets from disparate sources for use in advanced analytical models and products
* Use advanced ML processes to convert data from non\-functional forms, such as unstructured text or scanned image text, to functional forms ready for use in further ML models
* Use advanced ML models to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that can make predictions or reduce workload to make a significant impact across various domains within BC Cancer
* Lead the process of implementation of ML models into production by collaborating with developers and other stakeholders.
* Communicate analytic solutions to leadership and apprise leadership of AI product status throughout the various stages of the product lifecycle
* Implement improvements as needed to already implemented AI products


**Qualifications**
**What you bring**
* Level of education, training, and experience equivalent to a PHD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative field, 5\-7 years of experience working with large datasets and machine learning models.
* Advanced skills in AI product design and the analysis of quantitative data for the purpose of creating actionable insights and measurable impact.
* Thorough knowledge of the principles, processes, procedures and methods involved in data analysis, statistical methods, and machine learning.
* Demonstrated expertise in planning, organizing and coordinating AI product activities. Demonstrated proficiency with using advanced machine learning methods, machine learning software packages, and manipulation of large datasets.
* Knowledge and experience in statistical and data mining techniques including but not limited to: GLM and other regression, Bootstrapping, Random Forests, Boosting, Trees, text mining, social network analysis, simulation, scenario analysis, clustering analysis, decision trees, neural networks, and other methodology. Experience writing computer code, querying databases, and using statistical computer languages: Python, SQL, R, SAS and others Experience with distributed data/computing tools: Map/Reduce, Hadoop, AWS, Hive, Spark, Gurobi, MySQL, or similar. Experience visualizing/presenting data for stakeholders using: R, ggplot, Tableau, PowerBI, Matplotlib, D3, Periscope/Sisenseor other.

Show a clear commitment to identifying, challenging, and eradicating Indigenous\-specific racism and all forms of discrimination impacting equity\-deserving groups within healthcare settings. This involves recognizing personal biases, institutional barriers, engaging in anti\-racism education and training and advocating for systemic change.
* Knowledge and understanding of legislative obligations and provincial commitments within BC Cancer contexts found in the foundational documents including Truth \& Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015\), In Plain Sight (2020\), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019\), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women \& Girls Calls for Justice (2019\), the Declaration Act Action Plan and Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study, BC Human Rights Code, Anti\-racism Data Act and how they intersect across the health care system.

Embed Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility into all aspects of work. This means creating an environment where Indigenous patients feel respected, valued, and understood.  Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. The Senior Data Engineering Analyst plays a key role in collaborating with the Data Technology, Governance, and Data Science teams to modernize our data architecture. This position involves designing and constructing data pipelines, leveraging the analyst's expertise in data management, as well as cost optimization in data storage. The Senior Data Engineering Analyst provides support for business stakeholders, data analysts, cloud infrastructure teams, and data scientists regarding various data initiatives. The individual in this role should possess self\-direction and be adept at addressing the data requirements of multiple teams, systems, and products. This position is crucial in advancing our data platforms to enhance the next generation of products and services for our members.

* + - Work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality data solutions and ensure the integrity, availability, and performance of data platforms.
		- Design and deliver enterprise\-scale data pipelines and transformation workflows.

		- Design and implement DevOps practices including CI/CD, code reviews, automated testing and deployment, and cloud resource optimization for reliable and scalable operations.

	+ 10 years of hands\-on experience in cloud\-based data engineering, preferably in Azure environments.
	+ Deep understanding of Databricks, including data ingestion, transformation, and performance tuning.
	+ Proficiency in SQL and Python; experience building scalable ETL/ELT solutions using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, or Databricks DLT.
	+ Experience with dbt Cloud as a transformation framework is a strong asset.
	+ 5\+ years of data modeling experience, including schema design and dimensional modeling.
	+ Solid experience with CI/CD, Git\-based development, and monitoring pipelines in production environments.
	+ Familiarity with Power BI, machine learning workflows, and operationalizing models.
	+ Strong understanding of data science, advanced analytics, and agentic AI concepts.
	+ Exposure to data governance, data security, and regulatory compliance frameworks
	+ Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives and collaborate with both technical and business teams.
	+ Demonstrated passion for innovation, standardization, and driving efficiency through data.

We have a spirit that motivates us to give our best service to members every day. It's our values that attract many people to Servus – and keep them with us. We embrace our culture and heritage, and we pride ourselves on our strong commitment to the communities we serve and our efforts to build and maintain member loyalty. If this sounds like you, then we encourage you to apply!

Working for Servus has outstanding benefits. In addition to standard benefits like health and wellness, vacation and retirement savings programs, we also provide other important benefits such as:

* Training \& Development Opportunities
* Career Advancement Potential
* Flexible work options

* Meaningful work towards individual and corporate goals
* Opportunities to get involved and give back through an employee volunteer program

For information about these benefits and more, click here.


At Servus, our employees are also members. This means you'll have all the benefits of being a member of the credit union including profit sharing, voting for the board of directors, and all of the services we provide … with a few additional perks!

**What happens next?**


Only those applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. Should you require any accommodations during the hiring process, please advise us at that time.


*Discover a sense of belonging amongst a team of unique, authentic individuals working together to reimagine financial fitness. We value and celebrate the richness that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring to our community. Your skills, passion, and curiosity may find a sense of belonging at Servus, so even if you don’t check every box we encourage you to apply!*

title: Senior Earth Observation Scientist
description:
OUR VISION  

At EarthDaily Analytics (EDA), we strive to build a more sustainable planet by creating innovative solutions that combine satellite imagery of the Earth, modern software engineering, machine learning, and cloud computing to solve the world’s toughest challenges in agriculture, energy and mining, insurance and risk mitigation, wildfire and forest intelligence, carbon\-capture verification and more.  

  

EDA's signature Earth Observation mission, the EarthDaily Constellation (EDC), is currently under construction. The EDC will be the most powerful global change detection and change monitoring system ever developed, capable of generating unprecedented predictive analytics and insights. The EarthDaily Constellation will combine with the EarthPipeline data processing system to provide unprecedented, scientific\-grade data of the world every day, positioning EDA to meet the growing needs of diverse industries.  

  

OUR TEAM  

Our global, enterprise\-wide team represents a variety of business lines and is made up of business development, sales, marketing and support professionals, data scientists, software engineers, project managers and finance, HR, and IT professionals. Our SkyForest team, specializing in technologies tailored for forestry applications, including wildfire monitoring, forest carbon assessment, and tracking tree growth, is seeking an exceptional Senior Earth Observation Scientist to join our crew!  

  

READY TO LAUNCH?  

As a Senior Earth Observation Scientist, you will be responsible for leading the development of a machine learning model for wildfire risk. This role requires an innovator with extensive experience as an EO scientist and a keen ability to apply EO data creatively for fresh insights into forests and wildfire risk.  

  

PREPARE FOR IMPACT!  

As a Senior Earth Observation Scientist, you will be joining a dynamic team to guide development efforts, advancing our environmental monitoring capabilities and impactful projects.  

  

RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Develop machine learning models related to wildfire and forest fires based on Earth Observation data
* Utilize advanced remote sensing techniques to process and analyze multispectral time\-series of optical data and synthetic aperture radar data for comprehensive monitoring
* Develop and implement cutting edge algorithms for feature extraction, classification, and change detection, extracting meaningful insights from Earth observation data
* Lead the seamless integration of optical and SAR data to provide a holistic understanding of forest structure, health, and dynamics
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design and execute research projects aimed at addressing environmental challenges
* Stay at the forefront of the latest developments in Earth observation technologies, actively contributing to the continuous improvement of our methodologies
* Additional duties as assigned

  

YOUR PAST MISSIONS (AKA Experience)* Master's degree or equivalent in Remote Sensing, Geospatial Science, Physical Geography, or a related field
* Proven innovation experience in remote sensing of ecological systems
* Machine Learning experience with models trained on SAR and optical satellite data. Some expertise in ML pipelines, including creating models, cleaning data, A/B testing, the ability to test a model to see if it works, understanding explainable AI and some theoretical understanding of the basis of the models

  

YOUR TOOLKIT (AKA Skills and Knowledge)* Expertise in optical and SAR, image processing, pattern recognition, image classification and feature extraction, application of statistical methods for spatial analysis
* Strong proficiency in remote sensing software (e.g., ENVI, ArcGIS) and programming languages including Python for image processing and analysis and proficiency in R programming
* Expertise in developing and implementing algorithms for change detection.

  

YOUR COMPENSATION  

Base Salary Range: $120,000\-$140,000 CAD annually  

  

The compensation range provided is determined by several factors, including job\-related skills, experience, training, education, location, and business needs. This range reflects market data for Vancouver, BC and surrounding regions. Consideration for compensation at a higher end of the range will be given only to candidates who demonstrate exceptional qualifications and a proven track record of success relative to the position.  

  

OUR SPACE  

We’d love to welcome you to our SkyForest team for this remote opportunity. Ours is a fun, fast\-paced and exciting work environment where we hold earth\-smart (living sustainable), creativity and innovation, proactive communication, diversity, and accountability as our core values. Our SkyForest team is as innovative as the satellites we serve. And just like space exploration \- we're constantly evolving and pushing new technology boundaries.  

  

Hours of work typically fall between 9:00am and 5:30pm Monday to Friday with periodic cross\-over work required with other team members across a few times zones in addition to occasional evening and weekend work.  

  

WORKING ENVIRONMENT* Fully cloud\-native architectures
* Use of the latest advancements in computer vision and machine learning
* Occasional overtime
* Travel less than 4 times per year may be required

  

WHY EARTHDAILY ANALYTICS?* Competitive compensation, full benefits and flexible time off
* Be part of a meaningful mission as part of one of Canada’s most innovative space companies that are developing sustainable solutions for our planet
* Continuous employee growth and development including training from leading experts in the field in advanced topics spanning remote sensing to cloud\-native architecture
* Great work environment and team with a head office location in Vancouver
* Flexible working hours with work from home opportunities made to fit your life

title: Data Scientist, Category Expansion
description:

 Whatnot is the largest livestream shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. We’re re\-defining e\-commerce by blending community, shopping, and entertainment into a community just for you. As a remote co\-located team, we’re inspired by innovation and anchored in our values. With hubs in the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, and Germany, we’re building the future of online marketplaces—together.
   

  

 From fashion, beauty, and electronics to rare collectibles like trading cards, comic books, and even live plants, our live auctions have something for everyone.
   

  

 And we’re just getting started! As one of the fastest growing marketplaces, we’re looking for bold, forward\-thinking problem solvers across all functional areas. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business, and bring people together through commerce.
   

  

**💻 Role**
* Drive end\-to\-end analysis of revenue trends and category performance, surfacing what’s working, what’s not, and what needs attention.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses that help teams understand the “what” and the “why” behind performance shifts.
* Deliver descriptive analytics that help revenue teams understand current state performance across key revenue and category metrics.
* Build forecasts and directional models that support headcount planning, sales targeting, and business growth decisions.
* Provide insights within the context of the overall broader business and customer behaviors while given contextual specific details around individual teams needs
* Become a trusted partner to Sales, Marketing, Account Management, and Category leaders, helping them make smarter, faster decisions based on data.
* Build dashboards and automated reporting to support weekly and monthly business reviews, while driving clarity on KPIs that actually reflect performance.
* Support strategic decision\-making by creating forward\-looking insights — identifying leading indicators, pressure\-testing assumptions, and surfacing risks before they materialize.


 Required to be within commuting distance of our Los Angeles, Seattle, New York or San Francisco Hubs
   

  

**👋 You**
 We’re looking for an experienced, business\-savvy Data Scientist to join our growing Analytics team and help shape how we understand, measure, and grow Whatnot. This role supports Go\-To\-Market teams and sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, supporting teams like Sales, Marketing, Account Management, and Category Expansion with the analytics and insights they need to drive measurable business impact.
   

  

 You’ll focus on building clarity around business performance, revenue trends, and category growth through rich descriptive analysis and forward\-looking forecasting. From uncovering why a key metric is shifting to modeling where we’re headed next, your work will directly influence how we invest, prioritize, and operate. Critical to this role is empowering our cross\-functional teams with accurate insights in a form that empowers them to understand their business and take actions rapidly.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who thrives in cross\-functional environments and enjoys solving open\-ended business problems with thoughtful analysis, trusted reporting, and strong stakeholder partnership. Your work will help shape where we grow next, how we allocate resources, and how we define and track success at scale.

* Roles where supporting go\-to\-market, sales and marketing where understanding trends, connecting dots and forecasting was central to decision\-making
* Previous experience working with marketplaces, ecommerce, mobile gaming, or social media
* Expert in using SQL and scripting languages for data analysis, reporting, and dashboarding.

* You communicate clearly and influence without needing authority \- business partners value your judgment and seek out your input.
* You prioritize speed, clarity, and utility \- building tools and insights that the business actually uses, not scientific models that sit on a shelf.

* Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills to stakeholders, leadership, and investors

title: Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning Research Engineer
description:

 Gap International is a forward\-thinking consulting firm dedicated to leveraging cutting\-edge technologies to deliver innovative solutions tailored to our clients' needs. We are a team of passionate problem\-solvers committed to excellence and innovation. As part of our growth strategy, we seek an Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer to contribute in pushing the boundaries of AI and ML and create innovative solutions for internal as well as client\-facing projects within a dynamic, small company environment.  You will be part of a tight\-knit, productive, and highly collaborative research and development team. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and AI solutions to solve complex problems and improve operational efficiency within our organization. Your contributions have the chance to create significant impact on our products as well as the scientific community. The role involves working closely with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, explore and visualize data, build predictive models, and integrate effective AI/ML solutions into our internal processes and digital products.

* Collaborate with project stakeholders to define scope, objectives, and requirements for AI and ML\-driven projects.

* Document the development process, architecture, and standard operating procedures for models and systems.
* Work closely with IT and software development teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into our internal tools and workflows.
* Assist in identifying opportunities for leveraging AI/ML to gain competitive advantages in our consulting services.

* Completed a PhD degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a relevant technical field.
* Proven experience as an AI/ML Engineer, Data Scientist, or in a similar role, with a track record of designing and implementing machine learning models and algorithms.
* Strong programming skills in Python or other relevant languages, and familiarity with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, as well as various Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, AI agents, just to name a few).

* Ability to work independently as well as part of a collaborative team in a fast\-paced environment.

* Purposeful people at work impacting companies around the world.
* People who thrive in a learning environment and enjoy learning, growing, and performing at their best; energized to continually push beyond their comfort zone.

* Curious and flexible when it comes to their own growth and development, as well as receptive to coaching and feedback to maximize their potential.
* Willing to communicate and contribute thoughts, insights and new ideas to senior leaders both internally and externally.

* A role with significant impact and visibility within the company.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development in a supportive and collaborative environment.
* Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
* A dynamic and inclusive company culture.



  





**TO APPLY** 




 Please submit your resume which includes a list of publications, a cover letter explaining your interest and how your skills and experience meet the qualifications of the position, and any relevant portfolio or GitHub links showcasing your previous work or projects.
 



  





 Gap International associates are based out of our corporate office in the Philadelphia metropolitan area. In order to be considered for this role, applicants should be legally authorized to work in the US.

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!

 **Job Description** **Role Overview**


As a Pre\-Sales AI Architect, you will play a pivotal role in identifying, shaping, and securing new AI opportunities by bridging the gap between complex customer challenges and transformative, AI\-powered solutions. This highly consultative role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, business acumen, and communication skills. You will work closely with clients, account teams, and delivery leads to understand customer needs, design compelling AI solutions, and contribute to successful bid strategies and proposals.


You are expected to act as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and client stakeholders, translating real\-world challenges into scalable AI architectures that demonstrate tangible business value. Your work will directly support sales growth by influencing solution design, estimating effort and risk, and differentiating our offer through innovation and credibility.

**Key Responsibilities**


1\. Shape and Translate Client Needs into AI Solutions

* Lead discovery sessions to uncover business drivers, pain points, and AI opportunities.
* Map business requirements to AI/ML use cases and define value\-focused solution strategies.


2\. Design Scalable AI Architectures

* Architect end\-to\-end AI/ML solutions including model design, data pipelines, MLOps, and cloud integration.
* Leverage platforms like Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, Hugging Face, and LangChain.


3\. Drive Sales and Proposal Success

* Lead technical contributions to RFPs/RFIs, creating compelling narratives, architecture diagrams, and cost estimates.
* Shape bid strategy and differentiation using innovations in GenAI, LLMs, NLP, and computer vision.


4\. Communicate Value and Inspire Confidence

* Present complex technical solutions to business audiences in clear, value\-driven terms.
* Build demos or PoCs that validate solution design and inspire client trust.


5\. Collaborate Across Functions

* Partner with data scientists, engineers, and delivery teams to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with client needs.
* Support commercial modeling alongside sales, legal, and pricing teams.


6\. Track Trends and Advise on Emerging Technologies

* Monitor advances in AI (e.g., RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, Responsible AI).
* Educate internal stakeholders and apply emerging tools to strengthen proposals.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Experience \& Skills**

* Strong experience in AI/ML solution design, with a focus on pre\-sales, consulting, or client\-facing roles.
* Proven ability to align business problems with AI\-powered solutions in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Deep knowledge of AI/ML techniques (e.g., GenAI, supervised/unsupervised learning, LLMs, MLOps, embeddings, vector search).
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI tools/platforms such as Databricks, LangChain, Azure ML, and Hugging Face.
* Skilled in developing technical artefacts (e.g., HLDs), estimating effort/cost, and contributing to winning proposals.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills; able to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating in bid teams or with account executives, ideally in a consultancy or solutions environment.
* Awareness of data governance, security standards, and ethical AI considerations.
* Versatility to adapt solutions across industries such as public sector, utilities, health, and finance.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Version 1?**


At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits.

description:

The successful candidate will have strong data scientist skills and be highly analytical \- able to interrogate large datasets to extract performance insights and inform the future trajectory of our portfolio. They will be proficient in Excel (including pivot tables), experienced in writing Power BI reports, and ideally familiar with Precursive.


This role will require working closely with key stakeholders across the organisation, often at Director level, to provide actionable insights, performance reports and predictive analytics that support strategic delivery objectives and continuous improvement.


They will be an excellent communicator, confident in engaging senior leadership, and capable of translating complex data into meaningful business information. The ideal candidate will be pragmatic, delivery\-focused and a strong advocate for best practice.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Management of the Portfolio Management Office (PMO).
* Line management of the PMO Team, x3 Project Support Officers (PSO).

* Creation and management of best practice PMO processes and controls.
* Supporting, developing, and training of the PSOs in relation to processes and tools.
* Creation of high\-quality data analytic reports and dashboards to support board and executive\-level reporting.
* Development of regular utilisation and project performance reports to ensure delivery success and resource efficiency.
* Preparing board level reporting and taking executive\-level detailed minutes, actions, and decisions.
* Implementation and continuous improvement of project management processes and controls.
* Ensuring data quality standards across the Project Management team are adhered to.
* Effective stakeholder expectation management and communication.
* Financial responsibility: Collating and reviewing Portfolio Finances, challenging variances against forecasts with Programme Leads, and reporting discrepancies to the Director.
* Portfolio risk and issue management.
* Portfolio\-level dependency tracking and management.
* Resource planning and constraint identification across the Portfolio.
* Portfolio planning \- inflight and backlog project tracking and milestone assurance.
* Opportunity identification and prioritisation scoring in collaboration with Programme Leads.
* Project closure process and documentation compliance.
* Change request trend analysis and early warning insights.
* Lessons learned reviews to identify and act on themes and trends.
* Benefits identification and realisation tracking across programmes/projects.

**Requirements:**

* Experience working as a PMO Manager or similar leadership role within a mid/large corporate PMO function. Minimum 5 years' PMO experience.
* Experience in resource management, RAID management, change control and benefits realisation.
* Financial planning and performance analysis.
* Proactive and flexible, capable of both team collaboration and independent work.

**Essential:**

* Project Management qualification \- Prince2
* Power BI proficiency
* Advanced Excel (incl. pivot tables)

**Desirable:**

* Agile project qualifications (e.g. APM Agile Foundation / SAFe)
* Power BI dashboarding and reporting at executive level
* Experience with Precursive

**Skills Required:**

* Track record of managing programmes/projects with multiple teams within a formal methodology.
* Project Management qualification such as Prince2\.
* Demonstrable experience of Agile methodology and techniques.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience of commercial frameworks and working with 3rd parties.
* High\-level analytical and reporting skills, with strong planning and organisational capability.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including at senior/executive level.
* Experience of working with geographically distributed teams.
* A good understanding of matrix management structures.

**Applications:**

* MS Office including MS Project
* Jira / Confluence
* PSA system (Open Air, Precursive) i.e., time recording / resource management
* PPM tools (e.g., Monday.com or similar)
